nodes.title: Model loading and precision protection
widgets_values:
This workflow uses MiniMax H3 FP16 Exact Loader - Star7 and selects a safe compute policy across NVIDIA architectures: protected FP16 on SM75 and BF16 on SM80+. It also corrects an FP16 UNet setting accidentally forced by the launcher, so separate RTX 20-series and newer-GPU workflows are no longer required.

If you replace it with ComfyUI's default UNET Loader, do not force FP16 UNet on SM80+.

Model mirror: https://pan.quark.cn/s/27f28ba550dc

Install missing nodes through ComfyUI Manager so they can be updated normally:

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-chunk-star7.git

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-fp16-exact-star7.git

https://github.com/T8mars/comfyui-minimax-h3-audio-T8.git

nodes.title: Live Preview
widgets_values:
Live Preview uses an approximately 22MB TAEH3 decoder under ComfyUI\models\vae_approx. Both taeh3.safetensors and taeh3_decoder.safetensors are accepted.

When the decoder is missing, the node races the HF mirror and the pinned official GitHub source in the background, verifies the file, and starts previewing at the next eligible sampling step. Generation never waits for the download. Manual installation is only a fallback for network failures.

The preview overhead is small but not zero. Reduce the temporal sample count or preview long edge, or bypass the node when preview is unnecessary.

nodes.title: Sigma Shift and chunk acceleration
widgets_values:
The attention path must match the GPU architecture: use an SM75 path on RTX 20-series/SM75 GPUs and an SM80+ path on SM80 or newer GPUs. CK INT8 is the architecture-neutral baseline. An incompatible architecture stops with a clear error instead of silently substituting another backend. If CK on SM80+ reports unprotected FP16 before sampling, check the launcher precision settings or keep the FP16 Exact Loader in this workflow so it can correct the model precision.

Use the Sigma Shift values published with the LoRA. Common starting points are 6 / 3 for 4-step LoRAs and 12 / 3 for 8-step LoRAs. Bypass Sigma Shift to restore the default 12 / 3 behavior.

Under the same 1.0MP, 10-second, 24fps, 4-step reference-image workflow, CK INT8 measured 119.50 seconds/step and 620.32 seconds total; Sol SM75 All-INT8 measured 88.71 seconds/step and 442.57 seconds; SLA SM75 All-INT8 measured 60.83 seconds/step and 325.51 seconds. Sparse paths are faster, but quality depends on the content and settings. Hybrid combines CK and a sparse path on complete sampling steps.

8192 is a practical starting point for the chunk controls. A stage is reduced only after that stage runs out of VRAM. Keep Attention output memory protection on Auto for normal use.

nodes.title: Workflow export
widgets_values:
The export node can embed the workflow directly in the video. Dropping that video onto Prompt Load later restores the prompt used for generation.

Messaging and social platforms may recompress videos and remove embedded metadata, so send the original file when the workflow must be preserved. Video only does not write workflow metadata.

Video + workflow PNG also creates a compact workflow PNG using the first video frame as its cover, which is useful as a visual workflow template card.

nodes.title: Prompt guidance
widgets_values:
Prompt quality directly affects shot structure, motion, subject consistency, and sound design. An AI assistant can follow MiniMax's official Skill to draft the prompt; provide the reference image or video as well so it can describe the source accurately.

Official Skill:
https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/skills

nodes.title: Reference video
widgets_values:
Limiting the reference video's longest edge reduces vision-encoding time, generation time, and VRAM use. Set the limit to 0 to keep the source resolution.

The trim range follows the selected video's actual duration and accepts any valid start and end time; there is no fixed 15-second UI cap. Downstream processing uses only the portion that is actually available.

QKV chunking reduces long-sequence temporary VRAM peaks, but it does not replace a sensible reference resolution.

nodes.title: Reference image
widgets_values:
The maximum-long-edge limit reduces reference-image resolution, vision-encoding time, and VRAM pressure. Set it to 0 to keep the original size.

For first/last-frame conditioning, enable Crop to aspect ratio and select the same ratio as the generated video. The node takes the largest centered crop to avoid later stretching. Ordinary reference images do not require forced cropping.

nodes.title: LoRA compatibility
widgets_values:
The original LarryVRH minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600 requires the author's dedicated LoRA loader. Loading it through a generic LoRA node can blur or break the result.

The minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_comfyui_T8-convert variant works with ComfyUI's standard LoRA loader. A full-model LoRA may include layers that do not exist in a pruned checkpoint; the current chunk node applies the compatible layers and collapses mismatch reporting into one concise notice instead of flooding the log.

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:

Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 live-action, cinematic, photorealistic comedy video.

The humor should feel natural, fast, and deadpan rather than exaggerated.

<Subject 1> (S1) is a young Chinese man in his 20s, wearing casual clothes and sitting alone at a small outdoor café table.

<Subject 2> is a fat orange cat sitting on the chair opposite him.

[Shot 1]

Vertical 9:16 composition.

A static medium two-shot.

<Subject 1> sits at the café table with a cup of coffee.

Across from him, <Subject 2> sits upright on a chair like a person, staring seriously at him.

<Subject 1> looks at the cat and speaks in a frustrated tone:

<d>[Chinese] 我跟你说，公司最近真的太过分了。</d>

The cat remains completely still and keeps staring at him.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of the orange cat.

The cat slowly blinks once.

Without changing its serious expression, it raises one paw and gently pushes the café bill across the table toward <Subject 1>.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, reverse close-up on <Subject 1>.

He looks down at the bill.

His expression immediately changes.

He looks back at the cat and says:

<d>[Chinese] 你不是来安慰我的吗？</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, cut back to the cat.

The cat calmly turns its head away and looks toward the street.

Hold the deadpan reaction for the final second.

End abruptly.

overall_soundscape:

Natural outdoor café ambience with distant traffic, soft conversation, light wind, cup contact, and subtle table sounds.

Keep the cat completely silent.

The paper bill sliding across the table should be clearly audible and become the main comedic sound cue.

non_diegetic_music:

Very light playful pizzicato strings.

Keep the music low during the dialogue.

Add one short comedic plucked note when the cat pushes the bill toward <Subject 1>.

Stop the music abruptly at the end.
